tasks.short: Coordinate installation of the software system.
tasks.design: The developer reads the installation plan already accepted on {DOCS}, then coordinates the installation in person and notes exceptions. Coordination stays with them. Reading the plan does not install anything.
tasks.previous_blocker: The plan was hunted for in a folder, and the coordination was a series of conversations.
tasks.enabler_now: A plan that was already accepted can be opened. Coordination is still in person.
tasks.still_hard: People, timing, and exceptions still have to be handled by the developer.
tasks.human_edge: The developer coordinates the installation. The plan is only an input.
tasks.altitude: Coordination stays in full. Only opening the accepted plan is shorter.

evidence.claim: Opening a plan that was already accepted is a read. Coordinating an installation stays with the person on site.
EU rules require literacy for a person who uses a system that drafts text or code. A user-facing bot must identify itself as a machine. This design has no bot.

assumptions: The workflow starts when installation begins and ends when the developer has noted exceptions. They coordinate. The plan is only read.

The field is the accepted plan. A previous acceptance produces the plan. The developer produces the coordination and the exception note. If the plan is missing, they coordinate from what the installers have.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree coordination stays.
unknowns: Whether an accepted installation plan already exists to open.
Who is on site besides the developer.

tasks.design: Supervision stays in person with the programmers, the technologists, the technicians, and the other scientific personnel. Nothing assigns a score and nothing records the conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision was already the work, and it was easy to replace with a dashboard of people.
tasks.enabler_now: There is no new tool. The work is the supervision.
tasks.still_hard: Judging the work of other people stays with the developer.
tasks.human_edge: The developer supervises. A list of tasks does not.
tasks.altitude: Supervision stays in full. The developer does not gain a dashboard of staff.

evidence.claim: Supervising programmers and technical staff is the work. It is not a report about them.

EU data-protection rules limit monitoring of staff to what is necessary and proportionate. National rules on employee monitoring differ. This design does not score a developer and does not record a supervision conversation.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the people are at work and ends when the developer has supervised them. Nothing is filed.
There is no new field. The developer produces the supervision.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree. Zero incremental hours are justified because no new tool and no new check are added.

tasks.short: Supervise staff and file assigned work.
tasks.design: Supervision of programmers, designers, and technologists stays in person. The developer assigns work to technicians and accepts that list. {PROJECT} files that version. Nothing scores a person and nothing assigns work by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assignment lived in a conversation and was written down a second time.
tasks.enabler_now: A project list can store an assignment the developer has already made and accepted.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding who does the work stays with the developer.
tasks.human_edge: The developer supervises and assigns the work. The file only stores the list they accepted.
tasks.altitude: Supervision stays in full. The developer still assigns the work. Only filing the list they accepted is shorter.

reach.task: Take work the developer assigned and accepted
reach.learn: The file is not permission to reassign it

evidence.claim: Assigning work is a judgement about people and the job. Filing the list they accepted does not choose the person.

EU data-protection rules limit monitoring of staff to what is necessary and proportionate. National rules on employee monitoring differ. This design does not score a developer and does not record a supervision conversation.

assumptions: The workflow starts when work needs an owner and ends when the accepted assignment is on the project list. The developer supervises and assigns.
The fields are the person, the work, and their acceptance. The developer produces all three. If they have not assigned it, nothing is filed.

steps.what: Read reporting formats the record stores.

tasks.design: The developer reads reporting formats on {PROJECT}, obtains security needs, evaluates costs, and determines the hardware configuration. They accept it. {DOCS} files that version. Nothing chooses the hardware.
tasks.previous_blocker: Formats, costs, and security needs were collected, and the configuration was retyped for procurement.
tasks.enabler_now: Formats the project already stores can be read. The configuration is still a judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Security needs and costs still have to be weighed by the developer.
tasks.human_edge: The developer determines the hardware configuration and accepts it.
tasks.altitude: The developer still obtains security needs, evaluates costs, and determines the configuration. The file stores only the version they accepted.

reach.task: Buy from a configuration the developer accepted
reach.learn: The file is not an order

evidence.claim: Stored reporting formats can be read. Security needs, costs, and the hardware configuration are a judgement.
EU rules require literacy for a person who uses a system that drafts text or code. A user-facing bot must identify itself as a machine. This design has no bot.

assumptions: The workflow starts when hardware is in question and ends when the accepted configuration is on file. The developer determines it. The file is not a purchase.

The fields are the format, the security need, the cost, and their acceptance. The project record produces the format. The developer produces the security need, the cost judgement, and the configuration. If a format is missing, they obtain it.
The prior classes this task as human. The steps agree the determination stays.
